description: Fetch one URL on a network HTTP agents cannot reach (gemini://, gopher://, ipfs://, ipns://) and return the text verbatim, plus an Ed25519 receipt that offweb fetched this URL at this time and got these bytes. Text only, 1 MiB cap. Refusals carry an `error` and nothing is fetched.
name: fetch
title: Fetch a gemini://, gopher:// or ipfs:// URL
